source_refs.title: Use Reminders on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap the Date and Time button to set a due date for the reminder.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Open the **Reminders** app. Tap **+ New Reminder**, then type your reminder. To set when it is due, tap **Date and Time**, then choose Today, Tomorrow, This Weekend, Next Week, or Custom. Without a set time, the notification appears at 9:00 AM by default.

source_refs.title: Use Reminders on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To mark a reminder as completed, tap the empty circle next to it.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: To mark a reminder as completed, tap the empty circle next to it. To delete without completing, swipe left on the reminder, then tap **Delete**.
